channel.title: Vice Capital — GTA 6 Guides
channel.description: Guides to the GTA 6 opportunity: markets, in-game economy, and the content economy.

item.title: GTA 6 Release Date, Editions & Pre-Orders (2026)
item.description: GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99. Pre-load Nov 12. No PC version at launch — here are the full details.

item.title: How to Invest in GTA 6: TTWO Stock, Targets & Catalysts (2026)
item.description: There is no "GTA 6 stock" — the pure-play is Take-Two Interactive (TTWO). Analyst targets, the Aug 7 earnings and Trailer 3 catalysts, peripheral plays, and the risks.

item.title: How to Make Money in GTA 6 Online: The Capitalist Playbook
item.description: The ToS-safe way to build wealth in GTA 6 Online: own income assets early, price your time, and move first. No glitches, no modded accounts, no bans.

item.title: The GTA 6 Map: All Six Regions of Leonida Explained
item.description: GTA 6 is set in Leonida, a Florida-inspired state nearly twice the size of GTA V. Here are all six regions — Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Hamlet, Kelly County.

item.title: GTA 6 Trailer 3: Expected Date, What to Watch For
item.description: GTA 6 Trailer 3 is projected for late July to mid-August 2026, ~3 months before launch. When to expect it, what it will likely show, and how trailer days move TTWO.

item.title: Is GTA 6 Coming to PC? Expected Release Window & What We Know
item.description: GTA 6 launches console-only on November 19, 2026. No PC date is announced — Rockstar’s history points to late 2027–2028. The pattern, the why, and how to prepare.
